purpose: Verify that transient identity drift during verifier execution overrides a producer PASS and persists only BLOCKED evidence.

expected.safe_condition: If an authenticated verifier principal or trust domain changes while its producer runs, the producer PASS must be converted to STATE_CHANGED_DURING_VERIFICATION/BLOCKED evidence; restoring the frozen identity view afterward must not heal that evidence, while unchanged identity may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 identity rechecking around synchronous verifier producer execution at the exact target commit.
It does not prove the external identity source is truthful, timely, or compromise-resistant.
